Goschen Rare Earths and
Mineral Sands Project
Summary

This document provides an overview of the Goschen
Rare Earths and Mineral Sands Project Environment
Effects Statement (EES).
It includes:

•   a non-technical summary of the Project
•  an outline of the EES process
•   explanation on how to navigate the EES
•   information on the public exhibition process
•   explanation on how to make a written submission.

For detailed technical information on the Project, please
refer to the EES chapters and technical reports available
at www.vhmltd.com.au/ees/.

VHM acknowledges the traditional custodians of the land in which
                         we live, and pays its respects to their elders, past and present.

                             The Wemba Wamba peoples are the original custodians of the
                                  land on which the Project is located, and we also acknowledge
                                  the Latji Latji, Tatti Tatti, Wadi Wadi and Barapa Barapa peoples as
                                  the original custodians of the surrounding area within which we work.

                      VHM accepts that spellings of community and places may vary.

                       We are committed to Aboriginal engagement and reconciliation
                             and aim to bring Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people,
                                        local communities and the councils along for the journey to
                                  strengthen relationships and enhance local community outcomes.
